import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

root = Path('.task-state/bakeoff-rounds-20261017')
q = root / 'qualifications/owner-resume-start-r4'
digest = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
landed = json.loads((root/'resume-context/owner-root-fixture-r5/parser-landed.json').read_text())['paths']
assert len(landed) == 17
closure = {}
for name in landed:
    raw = Path(name).read_bytes()
    assert raw == subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'e9b72808da5dc8998ecb765eac9bcd534e726025:' + name])
    closure[name] = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
pins = json.loads((q/'evidence/pins.json').read_text())
for kind, directory, key in [('baseline', q/'evidence/baseline-source', 'baseline_manifest_sha256'), ('candidate', q, 'candidate_manifest_sha256')]:
    manifest = directory/'approved-scripts.json'
    assert digest(manifest) == pins[key]
    assert json.loads(manifest.read_text()) == pins[kind]
    assert all(digest(directory/name) == expected for name, expected in pins[kind].items())
flow = root/'resume-context/resume-start-r4/OWNER-FLOW-CONTROLS-R2.py'
assert digest(flow) == '369c120b901b1ee3faeb642d6d498ef2ae0e5b98904c44d0b1a9c64c3a51e062'
assert flow.read_bytes() == subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'e9b72808da5dc8998ecb765eac9bcd534e726025:' + str(flow)])
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'e9b72808da5dc8998ecb765eac9bcd534e726025:' + str(q/'root_fixture_plan.py')]).decode()
new = (q/'root_fixture_plan.py').read_text()
assert old[old.index('    stage, window, output ='):old.index("\n\nif __name__")] == new[new.index('    stage, window, output ='):new.index("\n\nif __name__")]
files = {'root_plan_sha256': q/'root_fixture_plan.py', 'root_fixture_test_sha256': q/'test_root_fixture_isolation.py', 'root_coordinator_sha256': root/'root_resume_fixture_coordinator.py'}
for key, path in files.items():
    ast.parse(path.read_text())
    assert digest(path) == pins[key]
print(json.dumps({'status': 'HASH_CLOSURE_PASS', 'unchanged_landed_count': 17,
                  'unchanged_landed_sha256': closure, 'original_flow_sha256': digest(flow),
                  'unchanged_driver_stage_and_custody_suffix': True,
                  'owned_sha256': {str(p): digest(p) for p in [*files.values(), q/'evidence/pins.json']}}, indent=2))
